headline: Tugu Insurance (TUGU) Profit Reaches Rp495,15 Billion, Here's What Drives It
summary: PT Asuransi Tugu Pratama Indonesia Tbk, a general insurer in the Pertamina group, reported a 17.4% rise in net profit to Rp495.15 billion in the third quarter of 2026.
why: Tugu Insurance is a general insurer owned by the Pertamina group, the state oil and gas company, and its results reflect Indonesian non-life insurance demand.
original_headline: Laba Tugu Insurance (TUGU) Tembus Rp495,15 Miliar, Ini Penopangnya
